@inbox.description: Panel section header over the agents that are not running.

@unread.description: Right side of the inbox header: agents waiting on the user.

@running.description: Panel section header over the working agents, and the status word of a working agent.

@reconnecting.description: A source lost its connection and is retrying.

@appNotRunning.description: A source is down because its app is not open.

@noCommand.description: A source is down because its command line tool is not installed.

@cantOpen.description: Under a row whose jump failed.

@noProject.description: Row project name when the agent has none.

workingChildren: {count, plural, one {# subagent working} other {# subagents working}}

@workingChildren.description: Under a row whose subagents are still working.

@pendingApproval.description: Status of an agent waiting for a permission.

@awaitingInput.description: Status of an agent waiting for an answer.

@needsAttention.description: Status of an agent blocked for another reason.

@failed.description: Status of an agent whose run failed.

@completed.description: Status of an agent that finished and was not looked at yet.

@settingsMenu.description: Tray menu item that opens the settings window.

@followSystem.description: Language option that follows the system's languages.

@openAtLogin.description: Settings field: start the app when the user logs in.
